fixed_xyz_review.rationale: The β-diketone fragment bearing two mesityl groups is monoanionic. The C₈H₈ eight-membered ring has two strong carbon–carbon multiple bonds and is drawn as neutral cyclooctadiyne. Adopt Ir(I). The reported cyclooctadiene and the input hydrogen count are distinguished in the record
fixed_xyz_review.reference_scope: A conditional Lewis limiting form consistent with the original atoms, coordinates and net charge
fixed_xyz_review.electronic_state_evidence: The conditional Lewis graph uses input multiplicity 1. The physical ground state has not been independently established

input_review.case_basis: The bis(mesityl) β-diketonate C21H23O2 has its full H count; The remaining eight-membered ring should be C8H12 to satisfy same-ID H35. Two input ring alkynes replace two alkenes, This accounts for exactly 4H missing; ZAXYOM provides a crystal comparison for the same Ir(I)–cyclooctadiene motif

primary_evidence.chemical_reason: The β-diketone fragment bearing two mesityl groups is monoanionic.
